reviews.comment:
Quiero destacar la buena atencion de las chicas que trabajan en la YPF Full tanto turno mañana como turno tarde, ayer, despues de almorzar olvide una mochila con documentacion, computadora, y muchos objetos personales, volvi a las 6 horas y mochila estaba ahi, guardada tal cual la habia olvidado
No todo esta perdido en este pais, hay personas buenas y honestas como la gente que trabaja ahi. Muchas gracias!!

(Translated by Google)
I want to highlight the excellent service from the staff at the YPF Full station, both the morning and afternoon shifts. Yesterday, after lunch, I forgot my backpack with documents, my laptop, and many personal items. I returned six hours later, and the backpack was there, stored exactly as I had left it. Not all is lost in this country; there are good and honest people like the staff who work there. Thank you so much!
